title: Qualification and readiness claims
summary: Mandatory Builder qualification remains consumer-independent. Recovery ergonomics9 locally passed the browser shell, session readiness, composition controller, notNotes preview/live bootstrap boundaries, HTTP-front shell-tool syntax and package integrity checks; the actual Node-to-ooRexx HTTP-front A/B substitution was not executed in the authoring container and remains a host-side qualification step.
invariants: Do not report an HTTP-front implementation as qualified until the byte-identical A/B substitution has been run on the live host.
Do not report a session as Live merely because the WebSocket is connected.
Do not promote ergonomics8/9 over v0.11 without separate executable qualification and acceptance.
SOURCE rendering and DESIGN rendering are independently diagnosable semantic projections.
